item: row 361 group 6: the analysis title and note, Lead provenance panel, facet chips, filter note and loading lines follow a language switch
summary: Explore -> analysis: the analysis title and its note, the 'From this Lead' provenance panel (caveat, method, the plain trigger and the exact math), the article facet chips, the filter note, the launcher line and the Loading / still-computing / counting lines of the overview, trend, related, price, article list and form counts wrote t() output into ordinary nodes and froze in the language they were drawn in. They now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml (row 364) from what each was given; the provenance and chips moved into html builders (_anProvenanceHtml, _anArtFacetChipsHtml). A result drawn over a loading line by its own renderer lets the host go at once (row 364's observer), so the existing per-panel repaints keep owning the results. No new strings. Eleven lines leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt.
